svg.title: SPECTRE icon family
svg.desc: A set of 12 functional icons for the SPECTRE application UI, drawn in a consistent geometric style with 1.5px strokes.
svg.text: Icon family — 1.5px stroke, geometric, matches the mark's angular language
All icons use 1.5px strokes at 24px canvas. Red (#E24B4A) accents on threat-related icons only.
Geometric, angular forms echo the orbital-eye mark. No rounded-friendly aesthetics — this is an operational tool.
